title: The direct image of a sheaf along a continuous functor is a sheaf

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the direct image of a sheaf along a continuous functor between sites is again a sheaf (statement lines 2764-2770). The proof is a short but complete verification: for a covering of the source site the continuity assumption makes its image a covering of the target and identifies the relevant fibre products, so the sheaf condition for the direct image at the given covering is precisely the sheaf condition for the original sheaf at the image covering (proof lines 2773-2779). The non-formal content is the identification of the two sheaf conditions. The claim is H1: a single written-out verification.
